comment: I took her for ST Health Planning/Implementation (not Well 100). A very sweet professor with clear guidelines. She really cares about her students. Assignments are not difficult and are practical.
Take Heather for your well100. She doesn't take too long to lecture and lets you out of class early whenever she can.

Dr. Sadowshi is sweet, caring, and gentle. She is a very easy teacher, you just need to show up and not be on your phone to get credit. If you do miss a class, you will need to do a written assignment to make up for it, but she is very understanding of absences and is not very pressuring in regards to getting the make-up assignment in.
